title.description: The commit subject after 'fix Bug N - ': an imperative phrase saying what changed, about 60 characters. No bug number, no trailing period, no prefix.

summary.description: Two or three sentences for the reviewer: what was wrong, what the change does, and why that is enough. Specific to this change, not a restatement of the bug.

confidence.description: high = the edit removes the mechanism the analysis found and nothing else depends on the old behaviour. medium = it plausibly fixes the symptom but a caller or a platform variant was not checked. low = a best attempt.

not_verified.description: What you could not check here and a reviewer should - a build, a platform, a caller you did not open. Omit when nothing applies; an empty note is better than a filler one.
